title: Extended Type System and Standard Library
acceptance_criteria: Every supported type-system and standard-library construct has executable Parse/Resolve/Validate/IR evidence and applicable Generate/IDE evidence.
Unsupported forms fail with stable diagnostics rather than degrading or being silently discarded.
Public generic instantiations and stdlib identities produce deterministic versioned Canonical IR and compatibility facts.
Conformance claims are promoted only when executable evidence satisfies them.
